# prime-imagecompare

prime-rs: ImageCompare component (port of PrimeNG)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/imagecompare) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-imagecompare) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/imagecompare.md)

ImageCompare — port of `p-imagecompare` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

Markup and classes as in PrimeNG: root `div.p-imagecompare` with two views (`left`, `right`, usually `<img>`) and
a slider `input[type=range].p-imagecompare-slider`. Input on the slider clips the `clip-path` of the element in front of it
(the right image); the theme rule `img + img` sets the default clipping (50 %).

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_imagecompare::ImageCompare;

let html = Owner::new()
    .with(|| view! { <ImageCompare left=|| view! { <img src="a.jpg" /> } right=|| view! { <img src="b.jpg" /> } /> }.to_html());
assert!(html.contains("p-imagecompare-slider") && html.contains("type=\"range\"") && html.contains("a.jpg"));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-imagecompare = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["imagecompare"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
